mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_base.t_operation_base_user (operation_user_code, operation_user_name, id_number, phone_number, gender, role_level, enable_flag, remark) VALUES (#{operationUserModel.operationUserCode}, #{operationUserModel.operationUserName}, #{operationUserModel.idNumber}, #{operationUserModel.phoneNumber}, #{operationUserModel.gender}, #{operationUserModel.roleLevel}, #{operationUserModel.enableFlag}, #{operationUserModel.remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_base.t_operation_base_user SET enable_flag = CASE WHEN enable_flag = true THEN false WHEN enable_flag = false THEN true END WHERE delete_flag = false AND operation_user_code = #{userCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id, operation_user_code, operation_user_name, id_number, phone_number, password, gender, role_level, enable_flag, remark, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM operation_base.t_operation_base_user WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND delete_flag = false
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM operation_base.t_operation_base_user WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND delete_flag = false

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM operation_base.t_operation_base_user WHERE id_number = #{idNumber} AND delete_flag = false
